DESCRIPTIONS.article.list: List article metadata and author counts/latest dates; authors_scope identifies the statistics scope, not a source read.
DESCRIPTIONS.article.search: Find article leads and excerpts by query; not a full source read.
DESCRIPTIONS.article.read: Read one observed article ID with bounded start_line/limit; follow has_more.
DESCRIPTIONS.article.claims: Read cached source-anchored claims; an empty cache is not an empty article.
DESCRIPTIONS.tool.describe: Look up an allowed tool's parameters, or agent_action.v1 for action Schemas.
DESCRIPTIONS.material.get: Expand an authorized material artifact by character pages; follow has_more.
DESCRIPTIONS.web.search: Find public-source navigation leads; snippets are not read page evidence.
DESCRIPTIONS.web.open: Read a safe public HTML/text page; retain URL, dates, hash and pagination, not verified truth.
DESCRIPTIONS.market.catalog: List configured market symbols, units and market conventions; not price evidence.
DESCRIPTIONS.market.snapshot: Acquire daily data into a frozen authorized snapshot_id; not a realtime quote.
DESCRIPTIONS.market.metrics: Compute legacy deterministic metrics from an authorized frozen snapshot_id; no refetch.
DESCRIPTIONS.market.series: Read bounded daily bars from an authorized frozen snapshot_id; follow next_offset.
DESCRIPTIONS.personal.catalog: List frozen private Wiki/preferences/holdings handles; catalog discovery is not a source read.
DESCRIPTIONS.context.open: Read exact pages of an authorized personal context_id; retain source version and follow next_offset.
DESCRIPTIONS.company_wiki_search: Search authorized frozen Wiki facts; matching excerpts are not full-page reads or market facts.

SCHEDULER_DESCRIPTIONS.agent.spawn: Dispatch new research under the Run's budget policy; return its handle without waiting.
SCHEDULER_DESCRIPTIONS.agent.wait: Explicitly wait for selected child tasks, releasing this execution slot.
SCHEDULER_DESCRIPTIONS.agent.status: Inspect authorized child task/thread status and paginated events.
SCHEDULER_DESCRIPTIONS.agent.send: Send follow-up input to an authorized descendant thread.
SCHEDULER_DESCRIPTIONS.agent.cancel: Request cancellation of an authorized descendant task.
SCHEDULER_DESCRIPTIONS.agent.resume: Resume an authorized failed descendant without changing its model.
SCHEDULER_DESCRIPTIONS.result.get: Read an authorized result summary, full page or named section; follow has_more.
